name: godot-mcp-toolkit
description: Connects NPGameDev's Godot MCP Toolkit bridge (godot-mcp-server on PATH, @npgamedev/godot-mcp-server 1.0.2, commit 2034c32b) to the harness. Pairs with the godot_mcp_toolkit editor addon v1.0.2 in each Godot project. Ships only this manifest; the MIT bridge is installed from upstream.
